_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs' RedM egg (MIT).
name: RedM
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Cfx.re's multiplayer framework for Red Dead Redemption 2. Installs the server build you choose with Cfx.re's default resources; it needs a free licence key from Cfx.re.
startup: if [ -z "${CFX_LICENSE}" ]; then echo "RedM needs a licence key: get one free at portal.cfx.re, put it in Licence key on the Startup page, then start the server again."; exit 1; fi; d=/home/container/alpine; exec $d/opt/cfx-server/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1 --library-path "$d/usr/lib/v8/:$d/lib/:$d/usr/lib/" -- $d/opt/cfx-server/FXServer +set citizen_dir $d/opt/cfx-server/citizen/ +set gamename rdr3 +set sv_licenseKey "{{CFX_LICENSE}}" +set steam_webApiKey "{{STEAM_WEBAPIKEY}}" +exec server.cfg

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# RedM. Downloads the Cfx.re server (FXServer) build you choose for Linux,
# and Cfx.re's default resources. server.cfg and your resources are never
# overwritten; the server's files are only replaced once the download is
# complete.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

want="${CFX_VERSION:-recommended}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"
artifacts=https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_proot_linux/master

if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    url="$DOWNLOAD_URL"
    label="from $url"
else
    case "$want" in
    recommended | latest)
        info=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://changelogs-live.fivem.net/api/changelog/versions/linux/server) ||
            fail "Cfx.re can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
        url=$(jq -r --arg k "${want}_download" '.[$k] // empty' <<<"$info")
        [ -n "$url" ] || fail "Cfx.re didn't say which build is $want. Reinstall to try again."
        ;;
    *)
        builds=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$artifacts/" | grep -oE '[0-9]+-[0-9a-f]{40}' | sort -u) ||
            fail "Cfx.re can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
        b=$(grep -E "^${want%%-*}-" <<<"$builds" | head -n 1) || true
        [ -n "$b" ] || fail "Cfx.re has no build $want (it keeps only recent ones). Set Version to recommended, latest, or a build number such as $(sort -t- -k1 -n <<<"$builds" | tail -n 1 | cut -d- -f1)."
        url="$artifacts/$b/fx.tar.xz"
        ;;
    esac
    label="build $(sed -n 's#.*/\([0-9]*\)-[0-9a-f]*/fx\.tar\.xz$#\1#p' <<<"$url")"
fi

if [ -x alpine/opt/cfx-server/FXServer ] && [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-fxserver 2>/dev/null)" = "$url" ]; then
    echo "RedM $label is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading RedM $label"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/fx.tar.xz" "$url" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    mkdir "$build/x"
    tar -xJf "$build/fx.tar.xz" -C "$build/x" || fail "The download isn't a server build (an fx.tar.xz). Reinstall to try again."
    [ -x "$build/x/alpine/opt/cfx-server/FXServer" ] || fail "The download didn't contain FXServer."
    rm -rf alpine
    mv "$build/x/alpine" alpine
    echo "$url" > .raptor-fxserver
fi

# Cfx.re's default resources (chat, spawns, sessions), added where missing.
mkdir -p resources
if [ ! -d "resources/[system]" ]; then
    git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/citizenfx/cfx-server-data.git "$build/data" || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    cp -rn "$build/data/resources/." resources/
fi

if [ ! -f server.cfg ]; then
    cat > server.cfg <<'CFG'
# RedM settings. The port, name, player count and licence key are set from
# the Startup page; add your own resources with "ensure <name>".
endpoint_add_tcp "0.0.0.0:30120"
endpoint_add_udp "0.0.0.0:30120"

ensure mapmanager
ensure chat
ensure spawnmanager
ensure sessionmanager-rdr3
ensure basic-gamemode
ensure hardcap

sv_scriptHookAllowed 0
sv_enforceGameBuild 1491
sv_hostname "A RedM server"
sv_maxclients 32
CFG
fi
echo "Installed RedM $label."

variables.name: Licence key
variables.description: Your server licence key, free from portal.cfx.re. The server won't start without it.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The server build: recommended, latest, or a build number such as 38435.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once: 32 without a Cfx.re subscription.

variables.name: Steam Web API key
variables.description: A Steam Web API key for Steam sign-in, or none.

variables.name: Download link
variables.description: A link to an fx.tar.xz build to install instead of Version. Leave empty normally.
